ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite T1 FreeSurfer Scores

Source: R/data.R
ADSP_PHC_T1_FS.Rd

ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite T1 FreeSurfer Scores data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(ADSP_PHC_T1_FS)

Format

A data frame with 10526 observations and 412 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • ORIGPROT character Original study protocol , with options: ADNI1, ADNI4, ADNIGO, ADNI2, ADNI3

  • COLPROT character Study protocol of data collection , with options: ADNI1, ADNI4, ADNI2, ADNIGO, ADNI3

  • RID numeric Participant roster ID

  • PTID character Participant ID

  • VISCODE character Visit code

  • VISCODE2 character Translated visit code

  • PHC_LONIUID numeric LONI Image ID Range value: 25898, ..., 11433156

  • SUBJID character Subject ID used in NIAGADS for the whole genome sequencing data files generated by the AD Sequencing Project.

  • PHC_SCANDATE Date of scan Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • PHC_Visit numeric Harmonized Visit Number Range value: 1, ..., 18

  • PHC_Age_T1 numeric Age at each T1 visit Range value: 50.53251198, ..., 97.45106092

  • ScannerBatchName character MRI scanner model/batch, usually provided by the manufacturer.

  • ScannerManufacturer character Scanner Manufacturer , with options: SIEMENS, Siemens Healthineers, Philips, GE MEDICAL SYSTEMS, Philips Medical Systems, SIEMENS|PixelMed, Philips Healthcare, Siemens

  • FieldSgth numeric Strength of the magnetic field used in the MRI scanner, measured in Tesla. Range value: 1.5, ..., 3

  • EstimatedTotalIntraCranialVol_combat numeric Total intracranial volume harmonized with combat Range value: 833279.0411, ..., 2162780.553

  • Left_Lateral_Ventricle_combat numeric Left lateral ventricle volume harmonized with combat Range value: 1904.260411, ..., 83762.17127
